text: Sorry if this is muddled, I've been up with her for hours. Granddaughter, 11, temp is 39.9. She's got a little cough, nothing much. But she doesn't look right to me. Her skin is dark so it's hard to tell on her face, so I looked at her palms and the soles of her feet and they're very pale, almost greyish. Inside her bottom eyelids and her mouth look pale too, not the pink they usually are. And there's a patchy, mottled look on her legs. I don't know what to make of it.
